verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is a payments platform for agent-initiated commerce, so per-agent spend controls are a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence covers tokenization, UCP tokens bound to a specific checkout session and merchant, and shopper approval of each payment. Nothing documents configurable per-agent spend caps, usage limits, or instant revocation of an agent's payment authority; the 'cancel session' feature only releases reserved inventory.
